package.name: amr_fleet_control
package.description:
Multi-robot motion and traffic control: a payload- and speed-aware jerk-limited velocity smoother, a low-latency speed-dependent safety override, forward trajectory prediction, and a centralised conflict-aware traffic controller implementing a priority-based yielding protocol.
Every algorithm is a plain C++ class free of rclcpp, with the ROS nodes as thin adapters, so the control laws are unit-tested directly rather than through a simulator.
